title: A double click on Make Default saves once
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Have the shop's own active term A (made for this test), due 14 days after the invoice date.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Click "Make Default for New Customers".
  3. Double-click "Make Default" quickly.
  4. Open the "⋯" page menu.
  5. Click "Audit Log".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The confirmation opens.

Step 3:

  • The button turns disabled while saving.
  • Exactly one toast "term A is now the default" shows.

Step 4:

  • The page menu opens.

Step 5:

  • The Credit Terms Log holds exactly one new "Default changed" row, "COD → term A".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions), story SV-11681 (Story 12, Credit Terms audit log)

  • S2-R11: “The confirm button in the Make Default and Delete confirmations is disabled while the change is saving, so a double click saves once.”
  • S12-R3 table, default changed: “The default is changed (Story 2: Row menu actions) | "Default changed" | "{old} → {new}", for example "COD → Net 14"”
